reports.title: Largest Files
reports.purpose: Find the current File Locations consuming the most logical bytes.

reports.title: Largest Folders
reports.purpose: Rank analytical folders by recursive logical bytes.
caveats: Parent and child folder totals overlap by design; do not sum ranked folder totals to derive project total.

reports.title: Storage by Extension
reports.purpose: Show which filename extensions account for the most current locations and logical bytes.

reports.title: Storage by Source Root
reports.purpose: Compare current corpus size across observed source roots.

reports.title: Storage by Modified Year
reports.purpose: Show current locations and logical bytes by trustworthy filesystem-modified year.
caveats: Legacy/local-naive or otherwise unavailable UTC values remain separate evidence-state buckets.

reports.title: Files by Extension
reports.purpose: Describe the current corpus composition by filename extension.

reports.title: Files by Source Root
reports.purpose: Describe how current File Locations are distributed across source roots.

reports.title: Rare and Uncommon Extensions
reports.purpose: Surface extensions represented by only a small number of current locations.
caveats: The stored default query uses 5; implementation should bind the report parameter into the HAVING threshold.

parameters.name: max_count
parameters.description: Maximum current location count for an extension to be considered rare

reports.title: Exact Duplicate Summary
reports.purpose: Summarize the scale of authoritative current exact duplication.
reports.counting_unit: Exact Duplicate Group / Logical Bytes / Potentially Reclaimable Exact-Duplicate Bytes
caveats: Potentially reclaimable bytes are analytical, not a deletion recommendation or guaranteed free-space result.

reports.title: Largest Exact Duplicate Groups
reports.purpose: Rank current exact-content groups by potentially reclaimable physical bytes.
reports.counting_unit: Exact Duplicate Group / Potentially Reclaimable Exact-Duplicate Bytes
caveats: Groups with incomplete physical identity sort after known reclaim values.

reports.title: Duplicate Member Locations by Folder
reports.purpose: Show where current exact-duplicate member locations are concentrated.
caveats: This intentionally does not attribute reclaimable bytes to a folder; doing so would require a keep/delete allocation decision.

reports.title: Exact Duplicate Groups Spanning Source Roots
reports.purpose: Find exact-content groups whose member locations occur in more than one source root.

reports.title: Filename Divergence in Exact Duplicate Groups
reports.purpose: Find byte-identical content stored under multiple filenames.
reports.counting_unit: Exact Duplicate Group / Filename Variant Count

query_ast.label: Filename divergence in exact duplicate groups

reports.title: Extension Divergence in Exact Duplicate Groups
reports.purpose: Find byte-identical content stored under multiple filename extensions.
reports.counting_unit: Exact Duplicate Group / Extension Variant Count

query_ast.label: Extension divergence in exact duplicate groups

reports.title: Duplicate Participation by Source Root
reports.purpose: Compare exact-duplicate participation within each source root without assigning reclaimable savings to a specific root.
caveats: Participation is objective; per-root reclaimable-space attribution is not.

reports.title: Duplicate Participation by Extension
reports.purpose: Show which extensions contribute most to exact-duplicate participation.

reports.title: Reported Author Distribution
reports.purpose: Show reported Author values from current document analysis.
caveats: Reported Author is analyzer metadata, not independently verified authorship.

reports.title: Reported Author Availability
reports.purpose: Distinguish known Author values, explicit nulls, and unknown/unavailable Author evidence.

reports.title: Camera Make and Model Distribution
reports.purpose: Describe stored camera metadata for current image/RAW analysis.

reports.title: PDF Page Count Distribution
reports.purpose: Show the distribution of current PDF page counts.
dependencies: P2.5 physical strategy may use JSON, expression index, or typed analytical fact.

reports.title: Extracted Text Coverage
reports.purpose: Show how much current analyzable document evidence has stored extracted text and what failed or yielded empty text.
dependencies: P1-CORR-001 must be resolved before enhanced text identity/storage fields are trusted.

reports.title: Oldest Current Files
reports.purpose: Rank current locations by trustworthy filesystem-modified UTC time.
caveats: Unavailable/legacy local-naive UTC values remain separate and do not silently enter the true-UTC ranking.

reports.title: Old Large Files
reports.purpose: Find large current files last modified before a chosen cutoff.

reports.title: Current Analyzer Failures
reports.purpose: Show current analyzer failures by analyzer and extension with drill-down to affected locations.

reports.title: Current Location Evidence Problems
reports.purpose: Show current locations whose state prevents a normal present-file conclusion.

reports.title: Cloud and Offline Placeholders
reports.purpose: Show current paths identified as cloud-only/offline without hydrating them.

reports.title: Stale Hashes
reports.purpose: Show current locations whose stored hash/content identity is no longer authoritative for the current observation.

reports.title: Run and Coverage Health History
reports.purpose: Summarize run completion, warnings, and errors across project history.

reports.title: Archive Listing Completeness
reports.purpose: Show which current archive analyses have complete, capped, summary-only, or unknown member-list coverage.
dependencies: P1-CORR-002 must be resolved before completeness is authoritative.

reports.title: Observed Change History
reports.purpose: Summarize recorded file-location changes over project history.

reports.title: Locations with Multiple Historical Observations
reports.purpose: Find File Locations that accumulated multiple stored observation states.
caveats: This is location history; it does not establish move/rename continuity as one Logical Item.

deferred_or_rejected.title: Potentially Reclaimable Bytes by Folder or Source Root
deferred_or_rejected.reason: Reclaimable physical bytes are a group-level property. Assigning the saving to one folder/root requires choosing which physical copy survives, which is a Phase 3 decision. Use duplicate-member locations/bytes by folder/root instead.

deferred_or_rejected.title: Files by Media Class
deferred_or_rejected.reason: P2.6 reserves Media Class but no final deterministic classification rule/version is yet adopted. Extension and analyzer-specific reports already cover the initial need.

deferred_or_rejected.title: Generic Metadata Completeness Matrix
deferred_or_rejected.reason: The initial library includes concrete Author and Extracted-Text evidence-state reports. A generic field-state pivot should wait until implementation proves a clean generic state-of-field query surface.

deferred_or_rejected.title: Long-Unmodified Folders by Median Date
deferred_or_rejected.reason: Median/percentile aggregation is not part of Query AST v1 and the value of this report is not high enough to expand the aggregate contract before real use.

deferred_or_rejected.title: Old Downloads
deferred_or_rejected.reason: A hard-coded Downloads report is a special case of Old Large Files executed within a selected scope. P2.8 should make scope selection easy rather than create folder-name-specific analytical code.

deferred_or_rejected.title: Similar / Near-Duplicate Images
deferred_or_rejected.reason: Similarity is not exact duplication and feeds human adjudication/Image Game decisions.

deferred_or_rejected.title: Semantic Search / Topic Reports
deferred_or_rejected.reason: Phase 2 literal search is evidence retrieval; semantic model interpretation remains outside the initial Phase 2 product.
